candidates_note: Same scorer for every row (E4 = |aTarget - driver aEgo(t+0.5 s)|, human-controlled, lead present). lag = mean first time aTarget <= -0.5 around driver brake presses (negative = earlier). Formal pre-registered verdicts: nothing promoted.
